title: Cozy Christmas Procreate Brushes & Stamps | 212 Hand-Drawn Winter Elements
description:
Hand-drawn Procreate brushes and stamps for creating Christmas patterns, winter illustrations, and holiday surface designs. This set contains 212 individual elements: 50 leaf brushes, 10 wreath brushes, 20 Christmas tree brushes, 20 Christmas light brushes, 10 decor line brushes, 10 bauble stamps, 20 snowflake stamps, 10 plant stamps, 10 flower stamps, 5 Christmas star stamps, 7 Christmas item stamps, 5 animal stamps, 20 frame stamps, 10 star stamps, and 5 snow brushes. Every element is hand-drawn in Procreate. No AI involved.

The collection comes from sketching winter scenes and cozy holiday details. Each brush and stamp is hand-drawn with natural variation and intentional imperfections that feel authentic. The tree and light brushes give you quick festive compositions, while the snowflakes and bauble stamps let you build detailed layers. You get the structure you need without losing the handmade quality.

🎨 50 leaf brushes
🎄 20 Christmas tree brushes
